name: merge_two_cubes
why: Two cubes of 10 staggered by 2 in X and 5 in Z overlap by 8 x 10 x 5 = 400 mm3. United they make 1000 + 1000 - 400 = 1600, and ONE single body. The count of the bodies is the half that matters: a union that fails silently leaves two bodies where one was needed, the tree grows the same, the shape looks the same, and the difference only shows by counting.
_why_staggered: with two equal centred cubes the three results would be 1500, 500 and 500, and «subtract» and «intersect» would not be told apart. A case in which two wrong values of the enum give the same number tabulates nothing. Staggered, the three numbers are 1600, 600 and 400.

expect.why: two separate bodies that interpenetrate: the volume is the sum, because they are still two
counted on the document, not on the answer of the operation
a boolean redoes the faces from scratch, and whoever reads must re-read the part before naming them
